scenario.name: Custom workload
scenario.tagline: Your own processes, your own policy, executed by the real scheduler
scenario.description: Edit the process table (pid, arrival, burst, priority), choose FCFS, SJF, Priority or Round Robin, set the round-robin quantum and the per-switch cost, and optionally run the same workload through the self-healing control loop.
scenario.expectation: No fixed expectation: the result is whatever the engine computes for your input.

healing.summary: The controller ran for this workload but declared no incident: the monitored waiting time never crossed its threshold, so no policy change was attempted.
healing.final_text: No intervention; the initial policy ran to the end of the trace.
